channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Clyde Drexler | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Clyde Drexler from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephen Silas on Clyde Drexler, Hakeem Olajuwon, Calvin Murphy, Alperen Sengun
item.description:
Mark Berman:Stephen Silas on Hakeem Olajuwon working with @Alperen Sengun:

“Having Hakeem teaching you is like unbelievable. One of the great things of being a Houston Rocket you have so many people willing to help especially guys like him, Rudy T, Calvin Murphy.. Clyde Drexler.. It’s great.”

Stephen Silas on Clyde Drexler, Hakeem Olajuwon, Calvin Murphy, Alperen Sengun, Feb 6, 2022. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Dominique Wilkins on Michael Jordan, Danny Ainge, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Clyde Drexler
item.description:
Dominique Wilkins:

“It’s frustrating at times, but the thing that really satisfies me is that my peers know what I’ve done. The guys like Larry Bird and Dr. J and Michael Jordan and Clyde Drexler and Magic Johnson, they all know and they’ve all said some wonderful things. And I’ll tell you one of the guys who has [shown a lot of respect] too is Danny Ainge. Some of the things he’s said recently shed a lot of light on what I did. But when you don’t win a championship [it hurts your perception]. There are a lot of guys who didn’t win a championship, but does that diminish how great they were? No.”

Dominique Wilkins on Michael Jordan, Danny Ainge, Magic Johnson, Larry Bird, Clyde Drexler, Jun 8, 2018. Source: audioBoom.

item.title: Ice Cube on Clyde Drexler
item.description:
Jeff Kwatinetz and Ice Cube on Drexler:

“We were thrilled to have his early support as a coach for our inaugural season, and couldn’t be more pleased to welcome him to the executive team as BIG3 Commissioner.”

Ice Cube on Clyde Drexler, Mar 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Kobe Bryant on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Gary Payton, Stephen Curry, Clyde Drexler, John Stockton
item.description:
“To me LeBron [James[ is still a young kid. I can't even fathom that this is [year] 13 for him. That's crazy to me. And having the generations that come after that. The [Kevin] Durant generation, you have the [Stephen] Curry generation. There's just so many generations in between that. So it's going to be fun for me to be around them. When I first played in the All-Star Game, imagine a 19-year-old kid walking into a locker room and there's John Stockton with his little itty-bitty shorts, still. There's [Charles] Barkley. There's Clyde Drexler. There's Gary Payton. As a 19-year-old kid, that was&.[wow].”

Kobe Bryant on LeBron James, Kevin Durant, Gary Payton, Stephen Curry, Clyde Drexler, John Stockton, Feb 10, 2016. Source: ESPN.com.
